description: This file contains implementations of complex tensor operations and their registration within the PyTorch framework, including mathematical functions, tensor manipulations, and operator registrations specific to complex tensors.

classes.name: ComplexTensor
classes.description: A class representing complex tensors, supporting various complex-specific operations and manipulations.

methods.name: register_binary_linear
methods.description: Registers a binary linear operation with optional alpha scaling.

methods.name: real_impl
methods.description: Returns the real part of a complex tensor.

methods.name: imag_impl
methods.description: Returns the imaginary part of a complex tensor.

methods.name: is_pinned_impl
methods.description: Checks if a complex tensor is pinned in memory.

methods.name: register_like
methods.description: Creates a registered version of an operation that applies to complex tensors.

methods.name: cat_impl
methods.description: Concatenates a sequence of complex tensors along a specified dimension.

methods.name: sgn_impl
methods.description: Computes the sign of a complex tensor.

methods.name: sqrt_impl
methods.description: Computes the square root of a complex tensor.

methods.name: rsqrt_impl
methods.description: Computes the reciprocal of the square root of a complex tensor.

methods.name: addmm_impl
methods.description: Performs a matrix multiplication and adds to a complex tensor.

methods.name: elemwise_nonzero
methods.description: Checks if elements of a complex tensor are non-zero.

methods.name: register_nonzero_impl
methods.description: Registers a non-zero check operation for complex tensors.

methods.name: logical_and_impl
methods.description: Logical AND operation for complex tensors.

methods.name: logical_or_impl
methods.description: Logical OR operation for complex tensors.

methods.name: logical_xor_impl
methods.description: Logical XOR operation for complex tensors.

methods.name: logical_not_impl
methods.description: Logical NOT operation for complex tensors.

methods.name: view_as_real_impl
methods.description: Views a complex tensor as a real tensor with an extra dimension.

methods.name: linalg_vector_norm_impl
methods.description: Computes the vector norm of a complex tensor.

methods.name: copy__impl
methods.description: Copies data into a complex tensor.

methods.name: _local_scalar_dense_impl
methods.description: Extracts a scalar dense value from a complex tensor.

methods.name: allclose_impl
methods.description: Checks if two tensors are element-wise close within a tolerance.

methods.name: stack_impl
methods.description: Stacks a list of complex tensors into a single tensor.

methods.name: conj_physical_impl
methods.description: Returns the physical conjugate of a complex tensor.

methods.name: _conj_impl
methods.description: Returns the conjugate of a complex tensor.

methods.name: index_add_impl
methods.description: Performs an index add operation on a complex tensor.

methods.name: index_add__impl
methods.description: Performs an in-place index add operation on a complex tensor.

methods.name: masked_fill_impl
methods.description: Fills elements of a complex tensor with a specified value where mask is true.

methods.name: masked_fill__impl
methods.description: In-place fill of elements of a complex tensor with a specified value where mask is true.

methods.name: constant_pad_nd_impl
methods.description: Pads a complex tensor with a constant value.

methods.name: var_impl
methods.description: Computes the variance of a complex tensor.

methods.name: scatter_add_impl
methods.description: Performs scatter add on a complex tensor.

methods.name: scatter_add__impl
methods.description: In-place scatter add on a complex tensor.

methods.name: index_put__impl
methods.description: In-place index put operation on a complex tensor.

methods.name: tanh_backward
methods.description: Backward operation for tanh on complex tensors.

methods.name: diagonal_backward
methods.description: Backward operation for diagonal extraction on complex tensors.

methods.name: register_to_impl
methods.description: Registers an operation similar to `aten.to` for complex tensors.

methods.name: to_impl
methods.description: Implementation of `aten.to` for complex tensors.

methods.name: _to_copy_impl
methods.description: Implementation of `_to_copy` for complex tensors.
